A LITTLE CLARITY

Good questions.
Useful answers.

Do you currently offer warehousing or fulfilment?+

Please speak with our team about what you need. Storage and fulfilment availability must be confirmed before you make any plans.

Can I enquire about shipping furniture?+

Yes. Furniture, wooden items and home decor appear in the existing shipment categories. Acceptance and handling arrangements depend on the specific item and destination.

Can you quote without dimensions?+

Dimensions and packed weight are particularly useful for larger items. Provide the best available details, then discuss any measurements still needed with the team.
